'''Leonin''' is [[Warder]] to [[Meidani]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is [[Arafellin]], and wears silver bells in his braided black hair.

== Activities ==
He accompanies Meidani back to the [[White Tower]] when she acts as a spy for the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]].
